item.title: Bhooth Bangla: Akshay Kumar, Wamiqa Gabbi's refreshing chemistry steals the show in Arijit Singh's song Tu Hi Disda
item.description: Composed by Pritam, written by Kumaar, and sung by Arijit Singh and Nikhita Gandhi, Tu Hi Disda is the breezy romantic song from Bhooth Bangla. Directed by Priyadarshan, the horror comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Wamiqa Gabbi, Tabu, Mithila Palkar, Paresh Rawal, Rajpal Yadav, and late Asrani.

item.title: No Virat Kohli or Abhishek Sharma, Matthew Hayden chooses Gujarat Titans star as Mongoose Bat successor
item.description: In a recent event in Ahmedabad, former Australian batter Matthew Hayden chose heir to his iconic Mongoose Bat, and he is not Abhishek Sharma, Hardik Pandya, or Virat Kohli.

item.title: Pakistan Fails: Iran rejects peace initiative, fires missiles at Israel despite Donald Trump's de-escalation move
item.description: Pakistan has failed again, this time in brokering peace between its Muslim brethren Iran and ally the US. Rejecting its overtures for talks, Tehran has fired scores of missiles at Israel. Details here.

item.title: Dhurandhar 2: Samajwadi Party MP Afzal Ansari slams makers for showing Atiq Ahmed's links with Pakistan-ISI, says 'they can throw up any name in the air'
item.description: Atif Ahmed's character in Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar: The Revenge is based on the real life UP politician and former gangster Atiq Ahmed, who was shot dead on live TV in 2023. In the film, Atif is shown to be working alongside Pakistan's ISI and underworld don Dawood Ibrahim.

item.title: Harish Rana, India's first passive euthanasia case, dies after 13 years in coma
item.description: Harish Rana, the first person in India who received permission for passive euthanasia, died on Tuesday at AIIMS-Delhi after fighting for life for 13 years in a state of coma. Rana had been in coma since 2013 and was moved from his Ghaziabad home to AIIMS.

item.title: Donald Trump calls PM Modi, discusses US-Iran war
item.description: US President Donald Trump just spoke with Prime Minister Narndra Modi on Tuesday. The two leaders discussed the ongoing crisis in the Middle East, including the importance of keeping the Strait of Hormuz open.

item.title: After PSL exit, Australian pacer Spencer Johnson joins CSK as Nathan Ellis' replacement for IPL 2026
item.description: The right-arm Australian pacer has become the third player, after Zimbabwe's Blessing Muzarabani and Sri Lanka's Dasun Shanaka, to ditch the PSL and join the Indian Premier League.

item.title: Exclusive: Saurabh Shukla admits he didn't had courage to approch Dimple Kapadia for Jab Khuli Kitaab: 'I was sure she will refuse'
item.description: Sourabh Shukla's directorial Jab Khuli Kitaab is getting praises on Z5. But do you know that Saurabh Shukla was hesitant to approach Dimple Kapadia? Read on to know why.

item.title: Akshay Kumar chose to play Raju after Priyadarshan offered him Shyam's role in Hera Pheri: 'Let Suniel Shetty be the hero'
item.description: Akshay Kumar and Priyadarshan's first collaboration was the 2000 cult classic Hera Pheri, that also featured Suniel Shetty and Paresh Rawal. The duo are set to reunite after 14 years in the horror comedy Bhooth Bangla slated to release on April 10.
